mutants.label: pull rebases onto the local branch's namesake instead of the sync target
mutants.find: pull_args = [*base_args, "origin", sync_target.target] if sync_target else base_args
mutants.replace: pull_args = [*base_args, "origin", sync_target.branch] if sync_target else base_args

mutants.label: push publishes a session branch under its own name (the stray-branch mechanism)
a pull that failed before its rebase still claims the repo was left mid-rebase
an unresolvable git dir counts as no rebase in progress (warning fails open)
[control] sync_manager: read the upstream's merge ref before its remote
mutants.why: Two read-only `git config --get` calls on independent keys inside _sync_target; neither reads the other's result and neither writes, so their order is inert wherever the resolver runs for real. The mocked pull/push tests pin _sync_target itself, so they never see the order either.
mutants.find:
up_remote = _run_git(["config", "--get", f"branch.{branch}.remote"], cwd).stdout.strip()
        up_merge = _run_git(["config", "--get", f"branch.{branch}.merge"], cwd).stdout.strip()
mutants.replace:
up_merge = _run_git(["config", "--get", f"branch.{branch}.merge"], cwd).stdout.strip()
        up_remote = _run_git(["config", "--get", f"branch.{branch}.remote"], cwd).stdout.strip()
